content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(Ivanti IF-T Pre-Auth Exploitation Tell Modeled from Appliance Telemetry) AND (BIOC(Ivanti-to-Windows Pivot: DcomSrv Service Created via vixDiskLib DLL Sideload) OR BIOC(Ivanti-to-Windows Pivot: /mail Scheduled Task Launching DeElevate64) OR BIOC(Ivanti-to-Windows Pivot: LSASS Memory Dump via Hollowed svchost)) — fires when the modeled Ivanti appliance pre-auth exploitation tell (source IP from anonymization infrastructure) is observed within a 24h window of any internal Windows persistence BIOC, stitching the appliance-plane and endpoint-plane signal into one incident an EDR-only stack cannot assemble because it has no appliance telemetry.
rules.name: Ivanti Pre-Auth Compromise Stitched to Internal Windows Persistence
